Quality Gates

The web documentation is generated without external pitfall scanners. Local quality gates live in the repository toolchain:

  • make validate for syntax, annotation completeness, SHACL, and examples.
  • make check-generated for deterministic generated artifacts.
  • make lint for Python, shell, Markdown, YAML, and static checks.
Generated from the GMEOW ontology. Canonical source is RDF/OWL; this site is a deterministic projection.
